leah.c: Announcing GA: FeatherStream is live on Hosted as of today. Purpose-built compact streaming for unstable networks and bandwidth-sensitive clients. Internal docs: https://internal.redwood.company/docs/featherstream :tada:
omar.t: Nice! How does it differ from existing streaming modes?
sophie.l: FeatherStream uses micro-chunks and a delta-encoding control frame, so clients receive minimal bytes for many incremental updates. It also supports an optional keepalive-less mode for sleeping devices.
leah.c: Enabling: pass stream_mode="feather" or use SDK flag in client 2.5.0+. Model suggestion: mosaic-feather for best latency/cost tradeoffs.
omar.t: Any behavior changes for function/tool-calls?
sophie.l: Yes — Feather batches tiny tool-call frames to reduce chattiness. If your integration depends on chunk-granular tool-call timing, test in the feather sandbox. Guidance in the docs.
leah.c: Ops notes: default per-connection token window is 3k, soft throttle at 100 rps/tenant. We auto-fallback to standard streaming if feather capacity constrained. If you require reserved throughput, use Dedicated or set reserved_concurrency.
deploy-bot: release/featherstream-gw succeeded 026-05-05 build 2026.05.05.412, canary 50% eu-west-1.
leah.c: Quick ask to devex and SDK teams: run the migration smoke tests and post results in #devex by EOD Wednesday. We'll do a demo + Q&A Thursday 10:00 PT. Thanks!
